validation.measured_by: src/nfl/fit_win_probability.py against the drive states src/nfl/plays.py reduces from the nflverse play-by-play; reproducible with `python -m src.nfl.plays && python -m src.nfl.fit_win_probability`
validation.note: points_per_elo is NOT fitted here: it is read from config/nfl_model.json, because it is the Elo model’s own answer to what a rating point is worth. sigma is the spread of the regulation margin about that call; overtime_home_win is counted, not fitted; tie_half_width is solved so the model’s kickoff tie mass matches how often games really end regulation level. Only time_exponent is searched, and it is searched on real drive-start states rather than assumed to be the random walk’s 0.5. The held-out numbers are what that run reported; pregame_brier is the same model with the clock stopped at kickoff, which is the number a scoreboard shows today.
